definitions.gloss: mutual aid; helping each other; cooperation
definitions.explanation: The act of people helping one another, especially in difficult times. Emphasizes reciprocity and community spirit.

examples.japanese: {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{精神|せいしん}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: The spirit of mutual aid is important.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{時|じ}には{地域|ちいき}の{助|たす}け{合|あ}いが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Mutual help in the community is needed during disasters.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}{近所|きんじょ}の{助|たす}け{合|あ}いのおかげで、{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}も{安心|あんしん}して{暮|く}らせる。
examples.english: Thanks to mutual help among neighbors, elderly people can live with peace of mind.

notes:
{助|たす}け{合|あ}い is the noun form of the reciprocal verb {助|たす}け{合|あ}う (to help each other). It emphasizes mutual, two-way support.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{精神|せいしん}: spirit of mutual aid
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{心|こころ}: heart of mutual help
- {地域|ちいき}の{助|たす}け{合|あ}い: community mutual aid
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}いの{関係|かんけい}: a relationship of mutual support

CULTURAL NOTE:
A core concept in Japanese community life, especially emphasized during natural disasters. {共助|きょうじょ} (mutual assistance) is a related formal term used in disaster preparedness contexts, distinguishing it from {自助|じじょ} (self-help) and {公助|こうじょ} (public assistance).

RELATED WORDS:
- {助|たす}け{合|あ}う: to help each other (verb)
- {協力|きょうりょく}: cooperation (more general)
